parsed.rationale: All eleven participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") of `EnvironmentValues` spread across six distinct packages — `AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, and `PlayerHeaderView`. In SwiftUI it is idiomatic and intentional to declare a separate `extension EnvironmentValues` in each file that introduces a new environment key; these extensions are not duplicates of one another but independent, domain-scoped additions to the same Swift standard type. The `fields_or_signature` list is empty for every record, so there is no evidence of shared members that could be consolidated. No restraint markers are set, but the structural signal is purely coincidental: the extensions share only the extended type name, not any content.
